summary: Read four clock digits with a colon between the hour pair and the minute pair. Some digits may be question marks. Replace every question mark with one decimal digit so the text names a real time of day. Legal times run from midnight through 23:59, and both ends count. Among every filling that passes this check, find the latest clock face and print it with two digits, a colon, and two digits. Some legal filling always exists.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
